camel_example: aliyun dcdn DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn telecom --EndTime '2015-12-10T21:00:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn hangzhou --StartTime '2015-12-10T20:00:00Z' --Layer all --Interval 300
description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer to query the queries per second (QPS) of an accelerated domain name by protocol
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer按协议查询域名的每秒访问次数QPS
kebab_example: aliyun dcdn describe-dcdn-domain-qps-data-by-layer --domain-name example.com --start-time 2015-12-10T20:00:00Z --end-time 2015-12-10T21:00:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en telecom --location-name-en hangzhou --layer all --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDcdnDomainQpsDataByLayer

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name that you want to query. You can specify multiple domain names. Separate them with commas (,). You can specify up to 500 domain names. If you specify multiple domain names, the data is aggregated. If you leave this parameter empty, the aggregated data for all your accelerated domain names is returned
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的加速域名。支持批量域名查询，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持500个域名，多个域名会按照聚合结果进行输出。
若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The minimum time granularity is 5 minutes. If you do not set this parameter, data in the last 24 hours is returned
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
最小数据粒度为5分钟。
不写默认读取过去24小时数据
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The time granularity for the query, in seconds.

Valid values are 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). The supported value depends on the maximum time span of a single query. For more information, see the table of supported time granularities in this topic
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询数据的时间粒度，单位：秒。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）取值，具体请参见使用说明中支持查询的时间粒度
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: The English name of the carrier. Call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to obtain the name. If you do not set this parameter, data for all carriers is returned
parameters.help_zh: 运营商英文名，通过[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~)接口获得，不传值代表所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en: The English name of the region. Call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to obtain the name. If you do not set this parameter, data for all regions is returned
parameters.help_zh: 区域英文名，通过[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~)接口获得，不传值代表所有区域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en: The layer to query. Valid values: \`network\` (IPv4 and IPv6), \`application\` (HTTP, HTTPS, and QUIC), or \`all\`. The default value is \`all\`
parameters.help_zh:
查询维度，可选网络层（IPv4、IPv6）或应用层（http、https、quic）或all。
默认为all
parameters.name: layer

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between each data record. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔，单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range that was queried

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range that was queried
